_comment: E2E suite definitions shared by .github/scripts/e2e-coverage.js (merge gate) and tools/release-kpis (KPIs). expectedSuites is the full freeze-stage matrix that releases-test-suites expands to per provider directory. checkNameFormats maps a suite to the check run name published by the check-run-results-to-pr Tekton task, minus the 'Release Tests / ' prefix; {capi} is the provider's CAPI name, e.g. CAPA. suitePathProviders maps a provider directory to the provider name used in cluster-test-suites paths. requiredSince is the day the merge gate started requiring the full matrix; suiteRequiredSince overrides it per '<dir>/<suite>' for suites added later, so that the KPIs do not expect a suite from release PRs created before it existed. Both are only read by tools/release-kpis.
